notes.zh: 新增 Android 原生高斯只读查看器：本机项目直接读取、完整高斯渲染、独立触摸相机、PNG 截图和原生诊断，不下采样。保留 App 内兼容查看。本版本需要安装完整 APK。
notes.en: Add an Android native read-only Gaussian viewer with direct local project access, full splat rendering, native gestures, PNG capture and diagnostics. No sampling. In-App compatibility view remains available. Install the complete APK for this version.
